name: Jolie
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, she features a soft brown shadow root that blends into a sandy mix of dark blonde and light brown. Fine beige-blonde highlights are woven through the lengths, with muted taupe tones adding depth. Pale champagne blonde pieces start right at the hairline, giving her a brighter face frame while the rest of the color stays softly blended.

All photos are taken in natural lighting. She arrives professionally colored and styled. Care for her as you would your natural hair and touch her up after unboxing if needed.

All sales are final. No refunds, returns, or exchanges.
